content: To know and not to act is not yet to truly know.
author: Chinese Proverbs
sourceWork: Zhi xing he yi (知行合一) — Wang Yangming & Classical Moral Lore
explanation: Intellectual accumulation is vanity if it never touches the hands and feet. You can recite entire libraries of ethics, philosophy, and health, but if you do not embody love, practice restraint, and act with justice, your knowledge is merely memorized noise.
practicalInsight: Take one piece of wisdom you frequently preach to others and strictly embody it in your own actions today.
reflectionPrompt: What profound truth do you intellectually understand, but continually fail to live out?
